item.title: Fact Brief: Does South Dakota have the smallest state capital in the nation?
item.description: The state capital of South Dakota – Pierre – has the second-smallest population of any capital in the United States. The smallest capital in the country is Montpellier, Vermont, with a population of about 8,000. Pierre’s population is about 14,000, ahead of Augusta, Maine, at about 19,000. item.description: South Dakota voters will have to prove they’re U.S. citizens when they register to vote under a bill in Pierre that becomes law.
